properties.description:
Implement search as the second stage of the search/filter work, after the earlier filtering upgrade works. Reuse its query evaluation, operator discovery, autocomplete, saved queries and composition by reference; search changes how matches are presented and navigated rather than introducing another query system.

For this MVP, open the control by clicking, apply queries manually, show a match count and provide previous/next match navigation. A separate results list and Ctrl+F/focus-system work are excluded. Plain text alone has no implicit search behavior. Before implementation, confirm the still-open interaction between search and an existing filter; simultaneous independent queries were discussed but not decided. The verbatim needs-analysis record is .harness/design/search-filter-needs-analysis.md.

Work in small reviewable iterations using the existing shared UI components. Verify the affected views and agent-facing query contracts, then have the user review search in the running app before final MVP acceptance.
properties.title: Add search using the upgraded filtering and query system
